headline: Marketing
that
*runs
itself.*
scenes.line: Hi, I'm Zack. Let me show you how AgentStack markets your listings for you, and where to find it.

headline: Start
in
*Campaigns.*
scenes.line: In the sidebar, open Marketing, then Campaigns. That's your campaign panel.

headline: One
listing.
*Every
channel.*
scenes.line: Pick a listing, and AgentStack drafts the whole campaign for you: a landing page, social posts, an email, a text, and a Google Business post.

headline: Nothing
goes
out
*without
you.*
scenes.line: Nothing goes out on its own. Review each draft, change anything you like, and approve it before it publishes.

headline: Add
*video
and
images.*
scenes.line: Want more? Open the property, and on its Assets tab, turn the listing photo into a short video or a branded image, where your account has it switched on.

headline: Put
it
on
*autopilot.*
scenes.line: To put it on autopilot, go to Settings, then Admin, and turn on auto-draft. Every new listing from your feed gets a draft campaign, waiting for your review.

data.label: Settings → Admin
data.value: Auto-draft a campaign for every new listing

headline: See
*what's
working.*
scenes.line: Then check Analytics for a plain-English summary of how it's going, and Site Health for tips to make your landing page work harder.

headline: Marketing,
*handled.*
scenes.line: That's it. Your marketing runs in the background, and you stay in control.
